headline: Anthropic pledges 5% of its shares to a fund for AI's economic impact
body: Anthropic announced it will put 5% of its shares into a new Public Benefit Fund for AI's economic and labour impacts, subject to stockholder approval, which lifted Shared Prosperity by 0.70. The same day its own study showed entry-level workers fell from 27% to 9% of its technical hires, cutting Shared Prosperity by 0.30. Meta described its gigawatt-scale Prometheus supercluster (Capability Velocity +0.11) and DeepSeek released the open-weight V4.1-Flash-1017 update. Egalitarian Utopia rose 0.31, the day's only notable move. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -14.03 from -14.11.
movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia +0.3, from Anthropic's Public Benefit Fund (+0.49), partly offset by its entry-level hiring study (-0.21). Reversion -0.1, mostly from Meta's Prometheus supercluster (-0.06). Benevolent Dictator -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.03) and the DeepSeek open-weight release (-0.03).
coming_up: Anthropic's Public Benefit Fund needs stockholder approval
